snippet.title: Food Truck Chef - Full Course Edition | Official Announcement Trailer | Steam & Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

Get ready to cook up a storm in Food Truck Chef - Full Course Edition, the ultimate time-management cooking simulator from Nukebox Studios! Start with a humble food truck and build your culinary empire by serving hundreds of delicious dishes, desserts, and customer favourites across addictive levels all arround the world.
Master fast-paced kitchen chaos: combine ingredients, upgrade your equipment to cook faster, unlock unique recipes, and satisfy demanding customers. Perfect for fans of cooking challenges, but with endless progression and food truck flair.

Wishlist Links:
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3653750/Food_Truck_Chef__Full_Course_Edition/
🕹️ Nintendo Switch (eShop): Coming Soon!

Add to your wishlist now and start your chef adventure!

Video editors: 
@juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
